end.summary:
Trisha practised recognising that families can differ in size and members; some examples were given, but this was not steady yet.
Trisha practised why household work matters and that anyone in a family can help; this is still building.
They said families live together and gave examples of a small and a large family.
The ideas that every family needs the same members and that only grown-ups can help remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised family differences and sharing household work through examples such as cooking, bringing water, and helping someone rest. Trisha gave some examples of families being different, but continued to say that every family needs a mother, father, and children and that children cannot help; these mix-ups were not corrected by the end. At home, talk about different family arrangements and choose one small safe task Trisha can do, such as putting away shoes or carrying a bottle.
